summary: The parsed entry combines cursing III and shoeing II under one root. Keep their existing sense 1 labels local to each stem; no additional numbered sense is required.

III now has finite Infectum manʕelox beside inherited Detransitive Part. Pass. manʕlo/manʕəlo. The latter is an epithet and does not assert a fresh cursing event. At 92/32 the snake's feminine referent does not by itself settle the morphological gender of printed manʕəlo.
II shoeing has newly attested Imperativ naʕəl and Infectum mnaʕela. Do not add an m- to the Imperativ from analogy, and do not interpret either as cursing.

The readers describe the shoeing material as a mistaken Detransitive gloss; in the actual supplied structure it is an nʕl² note attached to III. The correction therefore relocates the note rather than inventing a gloss change.
Inherited etymological alternatives remain unchanged; no contact origin is proven by the new examples. No light verb or new idiom is present.
